title: Dormancy and Suspension Periods on the Healthy Options Card
content:
Three periods govern a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card that is not being used, or that the plan has stopped. Each is a term of the tier.

| Card tier | Calendar days without a settled purchase before the card is treated as dormant | Charge for bringing a dormant card back into use | Calendar days a card stays stopped while suspected misuse is looked into |
|---|---|---|---|
| Core | 180 | 0.00 USD | 14 |
| Select | 180 | 0.00 USD | 14 |
| Plus | 240 | 0.00 USD | 10 |
| Premier | 240 | 0.00 USD | 10 |
| Dual Complete | 365 | 0.00 USD | 7 |
| Chronic Care Plus | 365 | 0.00 USD | 7 |

Read as conditions, for a card of the Supplemental Benefit Allowance Programmes:

- where the card is a Core or Select card, 180 calendar days without a settled purchase makes it dormant, and a suspension for suspected misuse runs 14 calendar days;
- where it is a Plus or Premier card, the dormancy period is 240 calendar days and the suspension 10 calendar days;
- where it is a Dual Complete or Chronic Care Plus card, the dormancy period is 365 calendar days and the suspension 7 calendar days.

Bringing a dormant card back into use is free on every tier: the figure in that column is 0.00 USD throughout.
